question: How does this programme work, for whom, and in which contexts?

wong2013.cite: Wong, Greenhalgh, Westhorp, Buckingham & Pawson (2013). RAMESES publication standards: realist syntheses. BMC Medicine 11: 21.
wong2013.checked: every quote read word for word in the Europe PMC full text (PMC3558331) on 20 Nov 2026; the article is online-only, so places are given as its sections and the explanations of its numbered items; in-text reference numbers are left out of the quotes

steps.title: Ask how
steps.text: Do not ask only whether a programme works. Ask for whom, in which circumstances, and why.

quotes.text: The realist research question is often summarized as "What works for whom under what circumstances, how and why?"
quotes.where: Background, What is a realist synthesis?

steps.title: Draft a theory
steps.text: Write down the programme theory: the ideas its designers had about how it should produce its outcomes.

quotes.text: reviewers may begin by eliciting from the literature the main ideas that went into the making of a class of interventions (the program theory). This program theory sets out how and why a class of intervention is thought to 'work'
quotes.where: Background, What is a realist synthesis?

steps.title: Search as you go
steps.text: Search for any kind of evidence that can test the theory, across disciplines, and search again as the theory changes.

quotes.text: Searching should be guided by the objectives and focus of the synthesis, and revised iteratively in the light of emerging data.

steps.title: Judge each piece
steps.text: Judge each piece of data, not whole studies: does it help build or test the theory, and was it produced credibly?

quotes.text: Relevance - whether it can contribute to theory building and/or testing; and
quotes.where: Item 9: Selection and appraisal of documents, explanation

quotes.text: Rigor - whether the method used to generate that particular piece of data is credible and trustworthy.
quotes.where: Item 9: Selection and appraisal of documents, explanation

steps.title: Find CMO patterns
steps.text: Look for recurring patterns: in this context, this mechanism fires and produces this outcome.

quotes.text: realism adheres to a generative explanation for causation - that is, an outcome (O) of interest was generated by relevant mechanism(s) (M) being triggered in context (C).
quotes.where: Item 11: Analysis and synthesis processes, explanation

steps.title: Refine the theory
steps.text: Test the theory against the patterns, change it, and test again. The result is a refined explanation, not a pooled effect.

quotes.text: The key analytic process in realist review involves iterative testing and refinement of theoretically based explanations using empirical findings in data sources.
quotes.where: Item 11: Analysis and synthesis processes, explanation
